title: Watching a test flight with John Lear and Gene Huff
summary: Bob Lazar tells of Watching a test flight with John Lear and Gene Huff, about 1989-03-22 at Nevada test site and Area 51, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.
place_text: about 8 miles east of Groom Lake, Nevada

tellings.quote: Yeah, because I had the test flight schedule.

plain: Bob Lazar, a man who says he worked on alien craft at a secret site in the Nevada desert, says that in March 1989 he took his friends John Lear and Gene Huff to a spot about 8 miles east of Groom Lake, home of Area 51, a secret US Air Force test base. He says they could watch a test flight because he had the test flight schedule. If true, it would mean he had real inside knowledge of when these craft flew.
